claims.text: The target is a multicomponent high-entropy material under high-temperature conditions.
The proposed intervention integrates high-throughput screening, multiscale modeling, and experimental validation.
The integrated intervention will improve determination of the transition temperature relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The integrated intervention will improve determination of fusion enthalpy relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The integrated intervention will improve determination of fusion entropy relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The integrated intervention will improve determination of volume change at the transition relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
The integrated intervention will improve determination of dense-fluid heat capacity relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
Phase transitions and critical phenomena mediate the effect of the integrated intervention on property determination.
Thermodynamic effects, phase transitions, and structural stability provide the causal mechanism for the predicted improvement.
Understanding of phase transitions and critical phenomena in high-entropy materials is limited.
